Interface Repository<ID,E extends Entity<ID>>

Type Parameters:
ID - the identifier type
E - the entity type extending Entity
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractFileRepository, FriendShipFileRepository, InMemoryRepository, UserFileRepository
public interface Repository<ID,E extends Entity<ID>>
Generic CRUD repository interface for managing entities.

  • Method Details

    • add

      void add(E entity)
      Saves an entity into the repository.
      Parameters:
      entity - the entity to store
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if entity is null or an entity with the same ID already exists
      ValidatorException - if the entity is not valid

    • remove

      Optional<E> remove(ID id)
      Removes an entity by its identifier.
      Parameters:
      id - the identifier of the entity to remove
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the removed entity, or Optional.empty() if not found
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the given ID is null

    • findById

      Optional<E> findById(ID id)
      Finds an entity by its identifier.
      Parameters:
      id - the identifier of the entity to find
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the found entity, or Optional.empty() if it does not exist
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the given ID is null

    • findAll

      Collection<E> findAll()
      Returns all entities currently stored in the repository.
      Returns:
      a collection of all entities

    • update

      Optional<E> update(E entity)
      Updates an existing entity.
      Parameters:
      entity - the entity containing updated data
      Returns:
      Optional.empty() if update succeeded, or Optional of entity if not found
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if entity is null
      ValidatorException - if the updated entity is not valid
